item.title: Greaves Electric targets 2x sales volume for Ampere escooter in FY27
item.description: "We have seen strong growth in this financial year, with registrations growing 92% year-on-year till October. Registrations in FY27 so far are over 72,000 units, exceeding the 62,644 units registered last financial year," Greaves Electric MD Vikas Singh told PTI in an interview on Thursday.

item.title: Germany and Austria call for European ownership of TikTok
item.description: Germany and Austria on Thursday called for TikTok's European business to be placed under European ownership and control, arguing that regulation alone cannot address concerns over data access and algorithms. In a joint statement, the two politicians called for "a European ownership structure for TikTok's European business and European responsibility for the key technological infrastructure -- from the recommendation algorithm to data access".

item.title: Investors see rising risk of SoftBank default as pressure grows on AI bets
item.description: SoftBank's five-year credit default swap spread, which measures the cost of insuring its bonds, widened more than 20 basis points to 534.6 bps, a four-year high. SoftBank's default probability sat at 34.8%.

item.title: Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says
item.description: MiniMax, which listed its shares in Hong Kong earlier this year, develops multimodal AI models - which can process multiple types of data - and consumer applications.

item.title: Apple pulls MiniMax AI chatbot from App Store over child safety concerns
item.description: Apple this week removed MiniMax's popular chatbot app Talkie from its App Store worldwide after media reports alleged that the product's AI-generated characters sent sexualised messages to minors.
